findings.reason: the dependency points at a section that does not promise the artifact the dependent reads, so §4's third clause would be met by whichever log survives rather than by a delivered measurement.
findings.text: §4 clause (3) requires "imas-efit's wall for the same case, read from the log of its §8 run on the nova-written rows", but §8's done-when (plan.html:190) requires only the code revision, the resolved basis/count/edge constraint and the state comparison, and never requires the imas-efit run's wall or log to be recorded, so an §8 node can satisfy its own endpoint and leave §4 with no source for clause (3)

findings.reason: the measure as written is unsatisfiable for any state whose flux datum differs, and one clause naming the additive gauge removes a false failure that §7 would otherwise inherit.
findings.text: §8 clause (2) compares "the boundary and axis flux within 2 % of the axis-to-boundary span after each state's stored flux sign is read", which handles only the sign convention, while the delivered §8 record had to gauge-align imas-efit's map to the generating axis flux by an additive constant (+0.3 Wb) before it could report the 0.09 % and 0.41 % flux agreements, so a converged run whose flux datum differs by any additive offset is refused on a band that says nothing about the reconstruction

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `/nova/spine-efit-parity` resolves as `docs/plans/spine-efit-parity.html`, `forward-solve-near-stored-states` as `docs/plans/forward-solve-near-stored-states.html`, and `/nova/figures/inverse-equilibrium-baseline/inverse-seam.svg` exists on disk.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §8 clause (2) bands the axis and boundary flux after reading only each state's stored flux *sign*, while its own delivered record had to remove an additive gauge constant (+0.3 Wb) before the axis flux could be compared, so the stated measure can refuse a sound run.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the plan's own record is `docs/evidence/archive/inverse-equilibrium-baseline-landed.html` (it exists on the primary checkout), and neither §4 nor §8 names a scratchpad or node-local temporary path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — neither section names a plan label, stage name or ticket number, and both stay at the level of records and bands.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — §8's generating state is drawn from imas-efit's resolved basis, so the wiring claim is checkable, its bands can fail (the delivered run already fails the cross-code q95 band at 0.148), and §4's ceiling is now arithmetic over a count measured in the same job rather than a fixed multiple.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §4 is one cost measurement of one reconstruction and §8 is one run of imas-efit on nova-written rows; each section's clauses are the parts of that one verdict.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — §4 clause (3) reads imas-efit's wall from "the log of its §8 run", but §8's done-when requires no imas-efit timing, so the dependent's input is not among its dependency's deliverables.
